headline: How to Get Irisalis
title: How to Get Irisalis in Aniimo | Legendary Journey Event | Aniimo Guide
video_script: There is a legendary Aniimo you can get right now. It is called Irisalis, and it arrived in the version one point one update. You get it through the Legendary Journey event, which runs until December tenth, twenty twenty six, so do not wait too long. Irisalis is also one of the top damage dealers on the tier lists. Have you started the Legendary Journey yet? Comment below!
description: Irisalis, Aniimo's legendary added in version 1.1, is obtained through the Legendary Journey event, running until December 10, 2026.
